name: file_edit
title: Edit File
description: Replaces exactly one occurrence of expected_text with replacement_text. Fails closed when the expectation does not match exactly once, or when expected_sha256/expected_mtime show the file changed underneath (optimistic concurrency). Prefer this for targeted changes instead of rewriting the whole file; use file_write when whole-content create/replace/append is intended.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

path.description: Absolute path of the file on the selected client.

expected_text.description: Exact current block; must occur exactly once.

expected_sha256.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency guard (hex sha256 of current content).

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
